card.text: Earth-sized planet of TRAPPIST-1, one year every 1.51 days.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1b is 1.12 Earth radii across and 1.37 Earth masses. It circles its star every 1.51 days at 0.012 au, receiving 4.15 times the sunlight Earth does.

temperature.title: JWST MIRI map
temperature.summary: Heat at 15 µm, mapped here from ten raw JWST visits. A hot day side and a dark night side: no sign of an atmosphere.
